item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Development, optimization and application of conventional and green analytical methods based on liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry ("Campus Bio-Medico")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 12:00
Institution: "Campus Bio-Medico", Rome
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-01 Chimica analitica, ambientale e dei beni culturali

The overall objective of the project is to develop, optimize and validate innovative analytical methods combining conventional and green sample preparation techniques with high-performance liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry analysis. These methods will be applied for the determination of different classes of molecules in biological samples of clinical and nutritional interest, as well as in food matrices, including endogenous bioactive compounds present in foods and agri-food industry by-products, and exogenous molecules.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Re s o l v i n g t h e c omp l e x i t y o f nanoparticle-cell interactions in real-time and at nanoscale (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-31 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma, Rm
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-02 Chimica fisica

The goal of this research project i s t o dissect the mechanisms o f intracellular trafficking o f nanoparticles and the interactions/reactions of nanoparticles with cellular components to ultimately program and manipulate the nanoparticle induced cellular responses. The specific aims of this project are the engineering of set of biodegradable phytoglycogen nanoparticles with tunable size, surface charge and functionalities and the study o f intracellular biological activities o f nanoparticles b y nanoscopy and spectroscopy methodologies.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Development, validation and application of advanced analytical methods and digital sensor systems to ensure food safety in the Italian durum wheat supply chain – SafeWeath. Supply chain agreement program (Univ. PARMA)
item.description:

Institution: Univ. PARMA, Parma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-07 Chimica farmaceutica, tossicologica, nutraceutico-alimentare, delle fermentazioni e dei prodotti per il benessere e per la salute

The programme aims to develop and apply advanced metabolomics and bioinformatics methodologies for monitoring the safety and quality of the national durum wheat supply chain. By integrating high-resolution mass spectrometry, targeted and untargeted metabolomics, multivariate data analysis, and artificial intelligence, the project will identify biomarkers for the characterization of raw materials, the monitoring of processing steps, and the detection of contaminants. item.description:

Institution: Univ. PARMA, Parma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-07 Chimica farmaceutica, tossicologica, nutraceutico-alimentare, delle fermentazioni e dei prodotti per il benessere e per la salute

The research programme aims to develop and apply advanced metabolomics approaches for the characterization of grape biodiversity and the quality of wine production. Using high-resolution mass spectrometry together with targeted and untargeted metabolomics, the chemical profiles of grape samples from different cultivars and agronomic conditions will be characterized. The resulting datasets will be integrated using bioinformatics tools, multivariate analysis, and machine learning approaches to identify biomarkers associated with quality, resilience, and sustainability. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Development of advanced materials for multisource bio-hybrid energy harvesting, project ERC EPIC (GA 101124721). (Sc.Sup. S.Anna PISA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-29 12:00
Institution: Sc.Sup. S.Anna PISA, Pisa
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-02 Chimica fisica

As part of the ERC EPIC (GA 101124721) project, the candidate will develop advanced materials for biohybrid multisource energy harvesting. The challenge is to engineer platforms to study and exploit energy conversion on natural surfaces, creating biohybrid energy harvesting systems. Using surface functionalization and structuring (e.g., self-assembled monolayers, etc.) and techniques like AFM, lithography, bioprinting, and tissue extraction, the researcher will develop materials integrated into microfluidic and artificial leaf platforms. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Novel Photocatalytic Strategies for Organoboron Chemistry - 2026_IDR_DCMC_22 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-06 Fondamenti chimici delle tecnologie

The project aims to develop innovative photocatalytic strategies for the sustainable synthesis of organoboron compounds (OBCs), fundamental in organic chemistry and crucial for the pharmaceutical and materials sectors. Since traditional methods based on carbanion chemistry are poorly sustainable, an efficient and eco-compatible approach driven by visible light is proposed. Photocatalysis grants access to open-shell intermediates under mild conditions, a reactivity suited to boron substrates, whose vacant p orbital favours radical stabilisation. Its core is the biomimetic design of the photocatalyst: natural photoactive cofactors will serve as templates for synthetic catalysts reproducing…

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 18:00
Institution: CNR - Istituto di chimica del riconoscimento molecolare, Milano
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-04 Chimica industriale

Research is focused on the synthesis of bio-based polyesters from platform molecules generated through lactose hydrolysis and hydrogenation. Activities include the physicochemical characterization of the resulting polymers, assessment of their processing and manufacturing performance, and the development and evaluation of functional packaging prototypes with enhanced properties and potential industrial applications.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Recovery and/or upcycling of organic material from rechargeable battery electrodes using non-conventional sustainable solvents (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-06 Fondamenti chimici delle tecnologie

Recovery and/or upcycling of organic material from rechargeable battery electrodes using non‑conventional sustainable solvents aims to establish low‑impact processes for selectively extracting, purifying, and revalorizing polymeric binders, conductive additives, and organic degradation products from spent electrodes. The project will design tailored deep eutectic solvents and maximize solubilization efficiency while preserving molecular integrity. Advanced spectroscopic analysis and electrochemical characterization will guide optimization of extraction pathways. The project will focus on the study of the effects induced by exposure to environmental contaminants in complex biological systems, with the aim of understanding the cellular and molecular mechanisms associated with the risk of chronic diseases. The activities will include sample preparation and treatment, the analysis of biological responses under different experimental conditions, and the evaluation of biochemical and metabolic alterations induced by exposure.
